name: ModelVariant445_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant445us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, uploads four images and sets up the work area, otherwise it runs one frame (sheets and ribbons helpers, phase and fade) and returns the phase result; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.

notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image (French header-462 images build it 12 bytes longer). See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
